basic_info.description: Luxury Live Auction! Bidding to start from $450,000.00!  Experience the very luxurious Gramercy Towers at the top of Nob Hill. Step into the meticulously maintained common areas, which include a welcoming lobby, a pool with a retractable roof, a spa/sauna, a well-equipped gym, and full concierge service - everything you need to relax and unwind. This unit offers sweeping south-facing views of the city. It has been updated and move-in ready. The HOA fee covers an array of conveniences, including a 24-hour doorman, earthquake insurance, heat, electricity, water, cable, internet, and garage parking space with additional storage.    Located directly across from the beautiful Grace Cathedral, just a block from Huntington Park, and along the iconic California Street Cable Car line, this home offers unparalleled access to the best of San Francisco. A short stroll takes you to Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, and many top-tier dining and entertainment options. Plus, with easy access to downtown via the cable car line, this location is perfect for work and leisure.
